objective: Determine whether the existing official Form 4 census supports one price-blind hypothesis about clusters of timing-non-routine insider sales during S1 Rush.

timing_classification.routine: At the filing date, the same owner and issuer had a qualifying S sale in the same calendar month in each of the three immediately preceding calendar years.
timing_classification.warmup: Before three full prior calendar years are observable, status is UNKNOWN_WARMUP.
timing_classification.candidate: After warmup, a sale not matching the routine rule is TIMING_NON_ROUTINE_CANDIDATE.
timing_classification.claim_limit: Timing-non-routine is a noisy public proxy and must not be described as informed or illegal trading.

evidence_basis.claim: Trades outside repeated calendar timing were more informative than routine trades in the cited historical sample.
Insider purchases were generally more informative than sales, requiring stricter treatment of sale evidence.
Official quarterly as-filed structured ownership data are public from 2006 onward; filings remain authoritative.
